issue.title: Remove stale sase-hq Symvision epic-symbol exemptions
issue.description: Discovered while running the mandatory just check after an unrelated split of src/sase/ace/patch/models.py. The Symvision stage fails before checking source symbols because Justfile lines 287-291 still pass five --epic-symbol exemptions for the now-closed sase-hq bead: EditorGlossaryProject, GlossaryConfigSignature, editor_glossary_catalog_for_prompt, leading_vcs_project_ref, and load_editor_glossary_catalog_for_prompt. Remove those expired entries, then rerun Symvision and clean up or otherwise resolve any newly exposed unused symbols according to the Symvision workflow. This currently blocks a clean just check for every workspace.
